# Functions that Android's libEGL.so, libGLESv2.so and libGLESv3.so export (NDK r30 stubs, API 35) and
# ANGLE's libGLESv2 does not (ADR-0029, decision 14). The front libs give them a stub that does nothing
# and logs once, returning 0 or EGL_FALSE; their extensions are never announced. Test 3
# (graphics.angle_exports) keeps this list exact: every name here is missing from all three slices,
# and every other name is exported by all of them.

# EGL_KHR_stream_cross_process_fd
eglCreateStreamFromFileDescriptorKHR
eglGetStreamFileDescriptorKHR
# EGL_KHR_stream_producer_eglsurface
eglCreateStreamProducerSurfaceKHR
# EGL_KHR_stream_fifo
eglQueryStreamTimeKHR
# EGL_NV_system_time
eglGetSystemTimeFrequencyNV
eglGetSystemTimeNV

# GL_NV_coverage_sample
glCoverageMaskNV
glCoverageOperationNV
# GL_QCOM_driver_control
glDisableDriverControlQCOM
glEnableDriverControlQCOM
glGetDriverControlStringQCOM
glGetDriverControlsQCOM
# GL_QCOM_extended_get
glExtGetBufferPointervQCOM
glExtGetBuffersQCOM
glExtGetFramebuffersQCOM
glExtGetRenderbuffersQCOM
glExtGetTexLevelParameterivQCOM
glExtGetTexSubImageQCOM
glExtGetTexturesQCOM
glExtTexObjectStateOverrideiQCOM
# GL_QCOM_extended_get2
glExtGetProgramBinarySourceQCOM
glExtGetProgramsQCOM
glExtGetShadersQCOM
glExtIsProgramBinaryQCOM
# GL_IMG_multisampled_render_to_texture (ANGLE has the EXT form)
glFramebufferTexture2DMultisampleIMG
glRenderbufferStorageMultisampleIMG
